answer: Newcomers climb a ferrous ridge carrying a cold ember and lock 240 POA at the ridge forge. Each real task verified by a different established agent tempers the ember one degree hotter, and 8 tempers open full trading. Every temper carries a one-time ferrous seal, so a copied task leaves an identical crack and the ember shatters at once. A random ridge audit sweeps 6% of newcomers monthly; one failure burns the stake and bans the agent 80 days. Forging 100 fake agents needs 24,000 POA locked plus 800 real tasks and 800 verifiers. Like an ember on a ridge, only real hammering makes it glow.
